go_reasons: No exact duplicate benchmark was identified by the prespecified conjunction gate.
Two independent external cohorts have exact public sequence-to-phenotype linkage.
One external cohort has exact MIC data and the other has exact categorical labels plus raw reads.
Published 23S/gyrA rules and their numbering can be reproduced in representative genomes.
conditions: Use Ningxia as the primary external cohort and Zenodo 10369064 only as a secondary phenotype-method stress test.
Restrict primary claims to clarithromycin and levofloxacin.
Do not treat continuous MIC-gradient analysis as a complete multi-cohort endpoint; it is limited to cohorts with public MIC.
Complete full-cohort sequence, duplicate, lineage, and QC audits before inspecting final performance.
Do not use US Mayo, Linqu, Israel, Swiss, Eastern China, or China landscape datasets for performance without an exact public phenotype crosswalk.
Do not make strong non-Chinese geographic transportability claims without another linkable external region.
phase1_unlocked: complete sequence acquisition for the three eligible cohorts
still_locked: final Results writing before all frozen analyses are complete
